title: The Classification chip is in the mobile filter sheet
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Use a phone, or a browser window narrowed to 390 pixels wide, signed in to the same account.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work orders list.
  2. Open the filter sheet.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list shows as cards.

Step 2:

  • The filter sheet offers "Classification" with All, Billable, Internal and No Charge.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R14: “While the Internal Work Orders setting is on, the work orders list shows a chip "Classification: All / Billable / Internal / No Charge" (the existing single-choice chip), default All, on every tab and in the mobile filter sheet. While the setting is off the chip is not shown; the badges on the rows stay.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: boards "01 Work orders list" (page "Flow 4 · Find internal and no-charge work orders"), "02 List · No Charge" (page "Flow 4 · Find internal and no-charge work orders"), "38 Work orders list · Classification" (page "Happy flow v6"), "03 List · No Charge, no results" (page "Flow 4 · Find internal and no-charge work orders"). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.
